proposed_cells.label: COMMODITY_BASIS_MOMENTUM_DATED_LAYER
proposed_cells.economic_mechanism: Basis-momentum - the trailing return of the HELD contract minus the trailing return of the DEFERRED contract - is a different quantity from the curve slope LEVEL that COMMODITY_CURVE_CARRY_SPREADS already settled. Slope level says where the curve is; basis-momentum says how the curve is MOVING, which is the hedging-pressure/inventory adjustment channel.
proposed_cells.novelty_claim: STRONGEST IN CAMPAIGN. Requires the deferred leg, which the back-adjusted continuation panel does not carry, so the 5846 continuation-panel tests could not have expressed it at any parameter.
proposed_cells.complete_trade: Long-only top-quintile and long/short quintile-spread variants over the certified dated-contract layer, cost charged on traded notional per market, roll cost explicit (R56 V2 measured roll cost at 77% of commodity drag - that finding binds here).

proposed_cells.label: COMMODITY_OPEN_INTEREST_POSITIONING
proposed_cells.economic_mechanism: Trailing growth in aggregate exchange open interest measures the arrival of risk-transfer demand. Producers hedging into a market pay a premium to speculators who absorb it; the premium should be observable in forward returns when OI is GROWING, not when it is static.
proposed_cells.novelty_claim: Open interest is never-used owned information. It is not a price transform, so no price-state hypothesis in the estate can be its duplicate.
proposed_cells.complete_trade: Cross-sectional rank of trailing OI growth across the certified dated-contract markets; long-only and long/short; cost on traded notional.

proposed_cells.label: EQUITY_EXTENSION_LIQUIDITY_PREMIUM
proposed_cells.economic_mechanism: Amihud illiquidity earns a premium because a holder of a thinly traded claim must be paid for the cost of exiting it. The premium's documented home is small caps; the estate has only ever tested it where it is most arbitraged.
proposed_cells.novelty_claim: CONTESTED - DIRECTOR MUST RULE. LIQUIDITY_PREMIUM is a settled family (R57 E8, plus machine variants). The claim is substrate, not mechanism.
proposed_cells.mandatory_honesty_note: The estate's strongest unqualified hypothesis is H_66753675_0067804439de, LIQUIDITY_PREMIUM, lockbox t 2.886. Its layer economics are D ann_net_excess -0.0006 (t -0.04, 2011-2017), V +0.0087 (t 0.31, 2018-2022), L +0.1374 (t 2.89, 2023-2026). Twelve years of nothing followed by 3.5 years of strength is a REGIME ARTIFACT unless the extension universe reproduces it out of that window. The burden correction (denominator 306, p 0.597) killed it correctly. This cell may NEVER be reported as reviving it.
proposed_cells.complete_trade: Long-only top-quintile Amihud on PIT MidCap 400 + SmallCap 600 members excluding PIT S&P 500 members, at a PRE-REGISTERED small-cap cost that must be set before measurement and never tuned.
